records.description: A fast, social party word game where one person secretly gets a different word, the Imposter. Everyone gives one-word clues trying to expose them, while the Imposter blends in without getting caught. Perfect for game nights, groups, and laughing nonstop. No accounts, no setup, just tap and play. Includes multiple categories, different modes, and endless fun.

records.name: BeyondGuard
records.tagline: AI security and governance platform, adopting generative AI
records.description: BeyondGuard helps enterprises use generative AI safely by adding real-time guardrails to every prompt and response. The platform sits between users and any LLM to block prompt attacks, prevent data leakage, and enforce company policies automatically. It works across internal AI tools, chatbots, and agent workflows without slowing teams down. Security and AI teams get full visibility—every action is logged, reason-coded, and audit-ready.

records.name: Passary, Zero-knowledge Password Manager
records.tagline: Your passwords. Encrypted locally. Zero knowledge.
records.description: Passary is a zero-knowledge password manager that encrypts your vault locally in the browser. Your data never reaches a server, and no tracking is used. You stay in full control of your passwords—no cloud, no blind trust, no compromises. Built for people who take privacy seriously.

records.name: Lightweight CMS
records.tagline: All-in one provider for your blog (No-code setup)
records.description: Set up a professional blog in minutes, no coding required. 1. Customize your blog page - Choose from enterprise quality templates 2. Connect your custom domain - Use subdomain or subdirectory structure, like /blog 3. Publish articles - AI writing assistant to research and write SEO-optimized articles faster Organic search traffic and AI citations are critical for growth. Lightweight CMS removes the technical barriers so you can start publishing high-quality, discoverable content today.

records.name: THEJORD
records.tagline: 14 free dev tools: JSON, PDF, Hash, UUID, Diff, 100% offline
records.description: THEJORD is a suite of 14 free developer tools that work 100% in your browser. No server uploads, no sign-up required. Dev Tools: JSON Formatter, Base64, Regex Tester, Hash Generator (MD5/SHA), Cron Builder, UUID Generator, Diff Checker, QR Code, XML/WSDL Viewer. PDF Tools: Merge, Split, Edit, Convert to Image, Compress. Key features: - 100% client-side processing - Your data never leaves your device - Bilingual (EN/IT) - Mobile responsive Built with Next.js 16 & TypeScript.

records.name: Vibe Commander
records.tagline: Integrated Vibe Environment
records.description: Your IDE needs 20GB of RAM and a coffee break to boot. This is one binary that launches before you finish blinking. Built for developers who live in the terminal with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or Codex. File tree, code viewer, git integration, and AI assistant — all in one place. No plugins. No config. No Electron bloat. Keyboard-first navigation. 5 color themes. Zero dependencies. 0% Human Slop. 100% Vibes.

records.name: CompressorX – Compress & Compare
records.tagline: Compress videos fast with clean before-and-after comparison.
records.description: CompressorX is a simple, fast video compression tool built for Mac creators. It helps you shrink files without guessing settings and includes a clean before-and-after comparison viewer so you can instantly see quality changes. Designed for both beginners and pros, CompressorX brings clarity to codecs, bitrate, scaling, and export workflows. It’s perfect for previews, social content, client deliveries, and everyday production tasks.

records.name: MindSubs 2.0 – Financial Health Manager
records.tagline: Track bills, set goals, boost your Financial Health Score.
records.description: MindSubs 2.0 is your Financial Health Manager. We transform passive tracking into active mastery—all ad-free. Key Differentiators: Financial Health Score: A dynamic score that gamifies budget discipline. Improve your score by beating spending targets. All-in-One Tracking: Track subscriptions, utility bills, and all one-time expenses in a single app. Actionable Tools: Set savings goals and use One-Tap Cancellation to immediately cut unwanted costs. Stop just tracking. Start saving.

records.name: TubeGuide
records.tagline: Convert YouTube to step-by-step notes
records.description: Turn YouTube tutorials into actionable step-by-step guides instantly. The #1 YouTube notes generator for students, developers, and self-learners. Paste a link, get a guide.

records.description: BON helps you reduce your credit card debt using AI. You get guidance, reminders, and personalized options that traditional apps never show. The best fintech app designed.

records.name: Check Supply

records.description: Check supply delivers your check by mail in as little as two days, with options for real-time shipment tracking and certified mail. Now on web!

records.name: viatza
records.tagline: Patient's Diary
records.description: Viatza just got a major update: a full Medications section, a clean timeline chart for your logs, flexible dose schedules (daily, weekly, cyclical, every-other-day, as-needed), and the choice between notifications or iOS 26 alarms. Symptom timelines, Home search, and new localizations (RO, ES, FR, DE, RU) are also here. A simple, private health notebook — all on your device.

records.name: LLMOlytic
records.tagline: How GPT-4o, Claude & Gemini understand your website
records.description: LLMOlytic shows how GPT-4o, Claude and Gemini understand your website — and gives you a 0–100 LLM visibility score. AI models are becoming new discovery engines: if they don’t recognize your site, you won’t appear in their recommendations. Enter a URL and get a structured analysis across 5 blocks: Knowledge, Functionality, Competitive Positioning, Sector Relevance and Perceived Quality. Try your first scan free.

records.name: Online Bill Split

records.description: Easily online Split Bill calculator, shared expenses, and group costs with our fast, accurate calculator. Divide by percentage or people in seconds.

records.name: Youtube Summary Pro
